ci_carrier_rank_1.description: Carrier contribution matrix [a_k * d(t)] for 6 layers. All columns proportional to the same GPS surface signal d(t). Rank = 1 verified by SVD.

cii_head_collinearity.status: MEASURED — seasonal band more collinear than trend band
cii_head_collinearity.note_on_duplicate: F1 dropped: F1 and T1 share wellcode 09050111 — exact duplicate. The 5e16 condition number in the original 7-column design was entirely this F1==T1 duplicate, not general collinearity.

raw_deduplicated.interpretation: Raw de-duplicated cond=19 — well-conditioned in the trend-dominated band.

standardized_detrended_seasonal_band.interpretation: Seasonal-band cond=19.9 — MORE collinear than trend band. Effective rank 5/5 in sub-annual band. The per-layer heads cannot supply the 6 missing DOF in seasonal band.

full_7col_duplicate_reference.note: 7-column design (GPS + 6 heads, F1==T1 duplicate included) — condition number diagnostic only.

verdict.not_claimed: impossibility at monthly or denser cadence — monthly cadence recovers F3 blind-era detrended r=0.862, proving the limit is sparse in-situ observation cadence, not an absolute barrier in the carrier+head framework.

amplitude_bound.label: Amplitude-bound (PROVEN, geometric)
amplitude_bound.description: F2 seasonal amplitude exceeds total surface seasonal amplitude — layer-to-surface inversion is non-unique by inspection.

carrier_rank_1.label: Carrier rank-1 (PROVEN, algebraic)
carrier_rank_1.key_number: carrier matrix SVD rank = 1 (all 6 columns proportional to d(t))
carrier_rank_1.description: All 6 layer carrier contributions are a_k * d(t). The carrier supplies exactly 1 shared DOF for 6 layers. Sum(a_k) = 0.559188. Fixed shares a_k are identifiable only from in-situ per-layer observations.

head_collinearity.label: Sub-annual head collinearity (MEASURED)
head_collinearity.key_number: Standardized detrended head cond=19.9, eff_rank=5/5, mean pairwise r=0.863
head_collinearity.description: 5 distinct head drivers (T1/F2/T2/F3/F4) standardized and detrended to isolate the seasonal band. Sub-annual heads are near-collinear: mean pairwise r=0.863, max=0.987. De-duplicated raw cond=19 (well-conditioned in trend band); seasonal cond=19.9 (MORE collinear after detrending). The 5e16 condition number in the original 7-column design was the F1==T1 exact duplicate, not general collinearity.

empirical.label: Empirical (PROVEN, Tasks B/C/D)
empirical.key_number: Annual F2/T2 skill <= 0 vs anchor-once baseline; F3 annual detrended r < 0.5 regardless of tau; coverage FAILS at semiannual; monthly cadence recovers F3 detrended r=0.862
empirical.description: Task B: annual F2 skill=-0.018, T2 skill=-0.092 (no dynamic skill beyond datum fix). Task C: F3 tau-uncap annual detrended r=0.44 < 0.5 threshold; monthly detrended r=0.862. Task D: semiannual coverage FAILS (3/6 layers); monthly PASSES (5/6).

soft_corroboration.note: Cancellation ratio 1.78x is soft corroboration, not a pass/fail gate. The amplitude-bound (exhibit a) is the incontrovertible geometric argument.

verdict_string: THESIS: sub-annual multilayer compaction dynamics are underdetermined and unrecoverable at sparse (annual/semiannual) in-situ cadence. SUPPORTED by 4 independent lines of evidence: (1) Amplitude-bound: F2=4.71 mm > A_surface=3.83 mm. (2) Carrier rank-1: all 6 layer carriers are a_k*d(t) — exactly 1 shared DOF. (3) Sub-annual head collinearity: standardized detrended head cond=19.9, eff_rank=5/5, mean pairwise r=0.863. (4) Empirical: annual skill <= 0 for F2/T2; F3 annual r=0.44 < 0.5; semiannual coverage FAILS; monthly cadence recovers F3 r=0.862. NOT CLAIMED: impossibility at monthly+ cadence.
